title: ReferenceRecord
description: Development-only analysis of one reference image. Maps a picture into DesignRecipe-space features + a verdict, with provenance/rights. Never bundled.

imageStem.description: Filename stem of the sibling image (e.g. 'grid-montage-europe-vintage-01').

verdict.description: Which reference bucket this belongs to.

reasons.description: Why we like/dislike it — the calibration signal.

features.description: Closest DesignRecipe-space description of the image. Any subset; use the same enums as design_recipe.schema.json.

nearestRecipeId.description: If a generated design matches this reference, its DesignRecipe.recipeId — links the bar to producible output.

rightsCleared.description: True only if we may store/use this image. Third-party images default false and must not be committed.
